answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5212 Country: India Title: I want to marry a women she already have two children from ex-husband my parants not allowed can i marry? Question: I want to marry a women she already have two children from ex-husband my parants not allowed can i marry? Answer ID: 5212 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 289/289=M/1429) To marry widow, mother of two children, is not impermissible in Shariah. And if you are mature, parents have no right to force you to get married on their choice. However, disobeying parents for no reason is a sin. Parents wish their children better, they will not suggest you a wrong proposal. You must obey your parents and should do Istikhara in this regard. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
